title: OreHider
description: A lightweight plugin that hides join, quit, and achievement messages for a cleaner chat experience.
body:
OreHider - Clean Chat Experience

A lightweight Minecraft server plugin that allows you to hide system messages for a cleaner and less cluttered chat experience.
✨ Features

    Hide Join Messages - Disable player join notifications

    Hide Quit Messages - Disable player quit notifications

    Hide Achievement Messages - Disable advancement announcements

    Fully Configurable - Enable/disable each feature individually

    Lightweight - Minimal performance impact

    Simple Setup - Just install and configure

📋 Configuration

Simple YAML configuration file:
yaml

# Hide join messages?
hide-join-message: true

# Hide quit messages?  
hide-quit-message: true

# Hide achievement/advancement messages?
hide-achievement-message: true

🛠️ Compatibility

Supported Server Cores:

    ✅ Paper

    ✅ Purpur

    ✅ Spigot

    ✅ Bukkit

Supported Versions: 1.16.5 and newer (tested up to 1.21.1)

Dependencies: None! Works out of the box.
📦 Installation

    Download the latest .jar file from Releases

    Place it in your server's plugins/ folder

    Restart your server

    Configure plugins/OreHider/config.yml as needed

🚀 Usage

After installation, the plugin starts working immediately. No commands required! Just edit the config file to toggle features on or off.
🔧 Commands & Permissions

Currently, all features are controlled via configuration file. No permissions required.
🤝 Support

Found a bug or have a feature request? Please open an issue on the GitHub repository.
